Weak, diffuse "sentence-completion" neuron: it peaks on the head word (usually the copula/auxiliary or main verb, sometimes the head noun) right after a long noun-phrase subject in a flat declarative/factual statement (rules, facts, descriptions) — the same tokens ("is", "and", "able") can strongly suppress it in other contexts, so it's positional rather than semantic.
